Helpers for using an aiui build output in a Next.js app, from the praisonaiui TypeScript package. Read the overview first: the package is optional and built from src/praisonaiui-ts.

Wrap your Next.js config. It does two things: adds a webpack alias @aiui pointing at configPath, so you can import uiConfig from '@aiui/ui-config.json'; your own webpack function still runs; adds md and mdx to pageExtensions. It does not add an MDX loader. To compile .mdx pages, configure one yourself (for example @next/mdx).
Turn a catch-all route's slug into a docs path. It returns only the path and slug; load the page content yourself (for example the Markdown that aiui build copies to /docs/).
